description: This file contains unit tests for internal memory management functions in the Abseil C++ library, specifically testing memory allocation, deallocation, and related utilities within the container internal namespace.

classes.name: TypeCountingAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that counts allocations per type for testing purposes.

classes.description: A test fixture for testing memory allocation and deallocation of std::string objects.

methods.description: Tests memory alignment when alignment is smaller than the base.

methods.name: Memory.AllocateDeallocateMatchType
methods.description: Verifies that allocation and deallocation match for a specific type.
